what: S8 T-0171: build failed because note-action.ts had a 'use server' directive with sync exports (Opus flagged it as a build risk in wave 1 but it was only noted); env-check failed on four E2E_* vars used by placeholder .e2e.ts specs
rule: A review finding that says the build will break must go back to the owning ticket before dependents run; env vars used by e2e specs belong in .env.example in the same ticket.
fix: Removed the directive from note-action.ts and documented E2E_* vars in .env.example by hand
